english.title: Sell animal to a person who had reasonable cause to believe is under 16 years - Animal Welfare Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sold an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..), to a person whom you had reasonable cause to believe to be under the age of 16 years
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 11(1) and 32(4) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
sold an animal to a person whom you had reasonable cause to believe U.16 yrs

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 11(2) provides that selling an animal includes transferring, or agreeing to transfer, ownership of the animal in consideration of entry by the transferee into another transaction.

other.timelimitforprosecutions: Complex see section 31 of the Act
other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

NOTE:
Section 32(5) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006 provides that In relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to 6 months.

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
Complex see legislation
